GitStride 1.0.5

macOS 14+ · Build 8

中文更新说明

  • 改善自动刷新连接：增加 WebSocket 心跳与超时处理，帮助连接失效后恢复事件接收。
  • 新增账号级个人待办，将个人工作与关注项目分开查看。
  • 优化项目和条目刷新，减少重复读取、计算与缓存写入。
  • 修复窗口导航和新增表单目标项目的状态干扰，完善编辑权限与批量操作结果。
  • 改善监控启动通知和 GitHub 限流后的恢复，修正 PR 可合并状态判断。
  • 精简菜单栏显示，将命令面板入口移到标题栏；支持详情页按 Esc 返回，并更新快捷键说明及本地化。

English release notes

  • Improve automatic refresh with WebSocket heartbeats and timeout handling to recover event delivery after a connection becomes unresponsive.
  • Add account-wide personal work, separate from followed projects.
  • Optimize project and item refreshes to reduce duplicate reads, computation, and cache writes.
  • Fix cross-window navigation and new-item project selection, and improve editing permissions and batch-operation results.
  • Preserve startup notifications, resume monitoring after GitHub rate limits, and correct pull-request mergeability checks.
  • Simplify the menu bar, move command-palette access to the header, support Escape to return from item details, and refine shortcut guidance and localization.

本次安装包仅适用于 macOS；自动化服务单独部署。

GitStride 1.0

First public release. Requires macOS 14 (Sonoma) or later.

  • Native menu bar access and a full workspace for GitHub Projects.
  • Board, Table, My Work, saved local views, and issue creation and editing.
  • Optional project notifications and pull request automation.
  • English and Simplified Chinese.

GitHub access and privacy

Desktop OAuth requests repo, project, read:org, and offline_access. The repo scope includes read and write access to repository code, including private repositories; it is broader than board access. OAuth credentials are stored in macOS Keychain. The GitHub Release build can alternatively use an existing GitHub CLI login.

Project snapshots are cached locally and can contain private project data. Optional pull request automation requires separate authorization and processes data on its hosted service. See the website privacy policy before enabling it.
